name: condemning-evisceration-non-assassin-class-bonus-prepare-not-offered
notes: Condemning Evisceration (r84E55KBLM, EXALTED/WATER ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 2, printed power 4): "[Class Bonus] Prepare 1. On Champion Hit: If Condemning Evisceration was prepared, you may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard. If you do, deal 4 damage to the hit champion." Player 2 keeps the deck's default Spirit of Fire champion (class SPIRIT, not an Assassin; lineage patched with WATER+LUXEM so the EXALTED/WATER card is playable) and holds a preparation counter. Because Prepare 1 is itself a [Class Bonus], it is never offered: the attack-target choice follows the last reserve payment, the counter is untouched and the hit deals only 4 with no banish offer.
